name: GCS
verdict: GCS is Griffin Core Solutions S.L., a Madrid aerospace company founded in 2021 and run by its administrators Alejandro and Sergio Molina Sanchez. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Sleeve sponsor since 2023-24 (club announcement, 15 September 2023) and in the 2026/27 La Liga sleeve-sponsor table (industry: aerospace). A private Spanish S.L. whose administrators are Alejandro and Sergio Molina Sanchez per the BORME; its shareholders are not published, and no state body or fund was found linked to it. No court, regulator, UN body or major-NGO human-rights finding against the company found.
